why: Evolution reels (phones, cars, planes) are evergreen viral transitions that everyone understands without words; huge global reach.

series.name: Evolution Of
series.style: clean studio product photography, the object centred on a plain gradient background, same angle and lighting in every stage, vertical 9:16 frame
series.negative: text, letters, words, watermark, logo, real people, celebrities, blood, blurry, distorted, painting, illustration, cartoon, CGI render, smudged faces, melted people, warped architecture, oversaturated colours
rules: One object type per reel, shown in the same pose every stage, from oldest to newest.
Labels are well-known eras or years (e.g. 1876, 1980s, Today). No brand names or logos.
Each stage clearly newer than the last.

topics: The telephone: from the first telephone to today's smartphone
The car: from the first motor car to an electric car
The aeroplane: from the first powered flight to a modern jet
The computer: from room-sized machines to a laptop
The television: from a tiny round screen to a thin smart TV
The camera: from a wooden box camera to a phone camera
The bicycle: from the wooden running machine to an electric bike
Music players: from the gramophone to wireless earbuds
Video game consoles: from a simple tennis game box to a modern console (no brands)
Light: from an oil lamp to an LED bulb
